image_description: Two cloth diapers (reusable nappies) placed side-by-side on a textured, brownish-yellow patterned surface (likely a rug or blanket). The left diaper is light blue/teal with white polka dots and visible snap fasteners. The right diaper is a slightly darker blue with similar white snap fasteners and elasticized leg openings. Both show the characteristic bulky, padded shape of infant diapers.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visible white circular snaps (a type of fastener common in cloth diapers) are present on the front panels of both diapers. While not 'adhesive tabs' like disposables, they serve the identical functional role for this subclass.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The background texture (rug/carpet) has a slightly repetitive, 'smudged' pattern typical of AI generation, lacking distinct individual fibers. It looks more like a painted texture than physical fabric.

The edge of the left diaper where it meets the background seems to lose definition slightly, with the fabric pattern bleeding into the background texture. The fold geometry is also slightly ambiguous.
The top edge of the right diaper's waistband curves unnaturally and lacks clear thickness, appearing slightly flattened against the background.
